videos.caption: Follow me and DM me "JEV" on IG/FB only 👇 Jev AI is a specialized model for classification and routing. It outputs probabilities instead of writing a response. ChatGPT and Claude look at information, reason through it, and generate text. Jev looks at the same type of information and makes a small decision fast. One engineer replaced ChatGPT Luna with Jev for a classification task. The engineer reported results 5 to 18 times faster, with greater accuracy. This matters because many AI agent workflows rely on repeated classification and routing decisions. Generating extra tokens adds work when the workflow only needs a label, score, route, or yes/no answer. Jev fits tasks such as sorting inputs into categories, choosing which workflow handles a request, ranking or scoring an item, and detecting spam, risk, intent, urgency, topic, or sentiment. The simple rule: use a general LLM when you need language. Use Jev when you need probabilities for a focused classification or routing decision. What is the Jev AI model?
